top_story.title: Vanguard’s S&P 500 ETF Just Hit $1 Trillion in Assets
top_story.summary: VOO officially crossed the line on Tuesday, Vanguard said.  The ETF’s rivals from BlackRock and State Street have some catching up to do.  BlackRock’s  has $859 billion in assets under management and the  the first U.S. ETF to debut back in 1993, has $785 billion, according to ETF Database.
